Kindle & Audible
Bring in the books you own on Amazon
Amazon doesn't let other apps connect to your Kindle or Audible library, so Grimoire never asks for your Amazon password. Instead, choose one of these:
Quickest
▦

Screenshot your library

Open the Kindle or Audible app, go to your Library, take a screenshot, and add it here. Repeat as you scroll.

›
Everything at once
⇪

Import your Amazon data

Takes a few days to arrive, but includes every Kindle and Audible purchase.

›
How to get your Amazon data
  1. On amazon.com, open Account & Lists → Your Account → Request Your Data (under Data and Privacy).
  2. Choose Kindle and Audible (or "Request All Your Data") and submit. Confirm the email Amazon sends you.
  3. When Amazon emails that your files are ready (usually within a few days), download and unzip them.
  4. Tap Import your Amazon data above and choose the CSV file that lists your Kindle or Audible titles.
